Create Complete Export Bundle

Source: R/model-export.R
export_bundle.Rd

Creates a complete export bundle containing: - Vetiver model for R deployment - ONNX-compatible model files (if supported) - Preprocessing manifest - Feature metadata

Usage

export_bundle(
  learner,
  model_name,
  task,
  output_dir,
  description = NULL,
  create_api = FALSE
)

Arguments

learner

A trained mlr3 Learner or GraphLearner

model_name

Name for the model bundle

task

The mlr3 Task used for training

output_dir

Directory for export files

description

Optional description

create_api

Logical, whether to generate Plumber API script

Value

List with paths to all exported files

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Create complete export bundle
bundle <- export_bundle(
  learner = trained_learner,
  model_name = "biomarker_classifier",
  task = my_task,
  output_dir = "model_export",
  create_api = TRUE
)
} # }
